notes.title: Battle royale mode, racing. Modes reveal
notes.content:
I am ready to announce the game's new upcoming modes lists 

1. Battle royale.
Mount a toilet and pee like sniper.
In this mode you ll shoot poo out of ass and will have to kill everyone with poo and pee.

2. Racing mode:
Mount a toilet and use the kinetic power of fart to move you forward and compete with up to 4 players!

3. Hard poo mode:
Characters have a really sturdy poo. So who ll poop faster wins! Upgrade your characters pooping apparatus to poop faster, gain perks.

4. Free standing pee

5. Different toilet maps:
Public toilet
Luxury golden toilet
University toilet
Metro toilet
Eastern toilet
Village toilet(sortir)
Transparent room toilet


6. With some of the Nvidia technology, I will be adding an abiloity to get drawn pee that will fill the entire toilet.

7. VR mode
8. Random character body

9. Ray tracing will be added in late february.

10. 9D mode. Play the game inside toilet.
You ll have a vr headset ingame and laptop on your knees both in game and real life. Total immersion. 
Also I am trying to get FeelReal for smell simulation

11. Poop with your friends
